headline: Amazon Cloud Capacity Sold Out Through 2027, CEO Jassy Says
summary: Amazon Chief Executive Andy Jassy stated that the company's cloud computing infrastructure capacity is completely sold out through 2027.
why: Amazon Web Services is the global market leader in cloud computing and Amazon's primary profit generator. Capacity constraints highlight sustained enterprise investment into artificial intelligence and digital infrastructure.

impacts.name: Amazon.com Inc
impacts.why: Sold-out capacity through 2027 secures strong forward revenue visibility for AWS.

impacts.name: Cloud Computing
impacts.why: Multi-year capacity backlog demonstrates resilient demand across data center computing.

why_moved: Amazon shares and tech sentiment gained after CEO Andy Jassy revealed AWS cloud infrastructure is fully committed through 2027.
